name: ModelVariant54_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant54_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (three textured trails spiral in towards the opposing slot and leave flaring glints at their heads, then a stack of textured rings rises around that slot while rising sparks fade out over their life and an optional white screen flash fades in the first frames); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-54 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant54_entry.c with GRAPHICS_DEFAULT_HEIGHT, VERSION_FRENCH at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
